results.question: How do I activate my license?
results.answer: To activate a license, open the plugin, click the **FR mark** on its panel, paste the license line into the field, and reload the session. Alternatively, use the `.frlicense` files: put them in `~/Library/Fruitless Research/licenses/` on a Mac or `%APPDATA%\Fruitless Research\licenses\` on Windows and reload the session.

results.question: Where do I put the .frlicense file on a Mac?
results.answer: On a Mac, put the `.frlicense` file in `~/Library/Fruitless Research/licenses/`. To find the folder, in Finder choose **Go > Go to Folder** (Cmd-Shift-G) and paste `~/Library/Fruitless Research/licenses/`. If the `licenses` folder is not there, create it.

results.question: I pasted my license but it still says unlicensed
results.answer: A license takes effect when the session reloads. Close and reopen the session (or remove and re-add the plugin). If it still shows "Demo ended - not licensed" after a reload, check that the line is for this plugin, or put the `.frlicense` file in the licenses folder. If none of that works, write to us through the [contact form](https://fruitlessresearch.com/contact/).

results.question: Do I need to be online for the plugins to work?
results.answer: No, you don't need to be online for the plugins to work. Your license is verified offline, on your machine, against a key built into the binary, and a license is checked offline with no account, no activation limit, and no server that has to be running for your session to open.

results.question: How do I get the old panel look back?
results.answer: To get the old panel look back, right-click the panel background and choose **Classic** under **LOOK**. This will change the look to the original dark panel, which is the same on every plugin. The choice is shared by all plugins and remembered, so every plugin will open with the **Classic** look until you choose its own look again.
